ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: Thelonious Monk This course will delve in depth into the work of jazz pianist, composer, and bandleader Thelonious Monk. We will look at his compositions, his approach to playing piano as a soloist and accompanist, and his work as a bandleader in both quartets and larger ensembles, as well as considering his biography, his cultural context, and the legacy and influence of his music.
